papers.title: Remote work expands pathways to upward career mobility
papers.abstract: Geographic constraints have long structured access to high-growth career opportunities, concentrating upward mobility within a limited set of cities and organizations. The expansion of remote work potentially alters this opportunity structure by decoupling job matching from physical proximity, yet its implications for career mobility remain unclear. Using 48 million U.S. job transitions between 2020 and 2024 linked to employer-level measures of remote eligibility, we estimate how entering remote-eligible jobs shapes career outcomes at job transitions. Workers entering remote-eligible jobs experience significantly higher wage growth and higher rates of upward seniority mobility than comparable workers entering fully on-site roles. These transitions are also associated with greater cross-metropolitan job mobility and moves toward smaller, less prestigious employers. Importantly, effects are largest among lower-income workers and those originating from regions with limited high-skill opportunity density. Together, the findings indicate that remote work relaxes geographic constraints in job matching, reshaping the distribution of upward mobility across places and workers.
papers.title_zh: 远程工作拓展了职业晋升的途径
papers.abstract_zh: 长期以来，地理限制一直限制着人们获得高增长职业机会的机会，向上流动性集中在有限的城市和组织内。远程工作的扩展可能会通过将工作匹配与物理距离脱钩来改变这种机会结构，但其对职业流动性的影响仍不清楚。利用 2020 年至 2024 年间美国 4800 万个与雇主层面的远程资格衡量标准相关的工作转换，我们估计了进入符合远程资格的工作如何影响工作转换时的职业成果。与完全在现场工作的同类工人相比，进入符合远程资格的工作岗位的工人的工资增长率和资历向上流动率要高得多。这些转变还与更大的跨城市工作流动性以及向规模较小、声誉较差的雇主的流动有关。重要的是，对低收入工人和来自高技能机会密度有限地区的工人的影响最大。总之，研究结果表明，远程工作放松了工作匹配的地理限制，重塑了不同地点和工人之间向上流动的分布。

papers.title: Online Generalised Predictive Coding
papers.abstract: This paper introduces an extension of generalised filtering for online applications. Generalised filtering refers to data assimilation schemes that jointly infer latent states, learn unknown model parameters, and estimate uncertainty in an integrated framework -- e.g., estimate state and observation noise -- at the same time (i.e., triple estimation). This framework appears across disciplines under different names, including variational Kalman-Bucy filtering in engineering, generalised predictive coding in neuroscience, and Dynamic Expectation Maximisation (DEM) in time-series analysis. Here, we specialise DEM for ``online'' data assimilation, through a separation of temporal scales. We describe the variational principles and procedures that allow one to assimilate data in a way that allows for a slow updating of parameters and precisions, which contextualise fast Bayesian belief updating about the dynamic hidden states. Using numerical studies, we demonstrate the validity of online DEM (ODEM) using a non-linear -- and potentially chaotic -- generative model, to show that the ODEM scheme can track the latent states of the generative process, even when its functional form differs fundamentally from the dynamics of the generative model. Framed from a neuro-mimetic predictive coding perspective, ODEM offers a biologically inspired solution to online inference, learning, and uncertainty estimation in dynamic environments.
papers.title_zh: 在线广义预测编码
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了在线应用程序的广义过滤的扩展。广义过滤是指同时联合推断潜在状态、学习未知模型参数并估计集成框架中的不确定性（例如估计状态和观测噪声）的数据同化方案（即三重估计）。该框架以不同的名称出现在各个学科中，包括工程中的变分卡尔曼-布西滤波、神经科学中的广义预测编码以及时间序列分析中的动态期望最大化（DEM）。在这里，我们通过时间尺度的分离将 DEM 专门用于“在线”数据同化。我们描述了变分原则和程序，允许人们以一种允许缓慢更新参数和精度的方式同化数据，这将动态隐藏状态的快速贝叶斯信念更新联系起来。通过数值研究，我们使用非线性（且可能是混沌的）生成模型证明了在线 DEM (ODEM) 的有效性，以表明 ODEM 方案可以跟踪生成过程的潜在状态，即使其功能形式与生成模型的动态有根本不同。从神经模拟预测编码的角度出发，ODEM 为动态环境中的在线推理、学习和不确定性估计提供了一种受生物学启发的解决方案。

papers.title: From Cortical Synchronous Rhythm to Brain Inspired Learning Mechanism: An Oscillatory Spiking Neural Network with Time-Delayed Coordination
papers.abstract: Human cognition emerges from coordinated spiking dynamics in distributed neural circuits, where information is encoded via both firing rates and precise spike timing determined by brain rhythms. Inspired by this notion, we propose a brain-inspired learning primitive in which cognition-level neural synchrony emerges through iterative bottom-up and top-down interactions between micro-scale dynamics of spiking neurons and a macro-scale mechanism of oscillatory synchronization. Specifically, we model each parcel (e.g., a cortical region or an image pixel) in the target system as a spiking neuron embedded in a predefined connectivity scaffold. Low-level information is encoded in a spatiotemporal domain, where neurons are selectively grouped and fire spontaneously over time through self-organized dynamics. In the bottom-up route, oscillatory synchronization is formed from past spiking activity accumulated over a finite memory window. Since brain dynamics operate in a regime of partial and transient synchronization rather than global phase locking, we model oscillatory coordination using a time-delayed synchronization formulation, which enables a top-down modulation of heterogeneous neural spiking for a large-scale distributed system. Together, we devise a spiking-by-synchronization neural network (S2-Net) that uses rhythmic timing as a control mechanism for efficient information processing. Promising results have been achieved across a broad range of tasks, including neural activity decoding, energy-efficient signal processing, temporal binding and semantic reasoning.
papers.title_zh: 从皮质同步节律到大脑启发学习机制：具有时滞协调的振荡尖峰神经网络
papers.abstract_zh: 人类认知产生于分布式神经回路中协调的尖峰动力学，其中信息通过放电率和由大脑节律确定的精确尖峰时间进行编码。受这一概念的启发，我们提出了一种受大脑启发的学习原语，其中认知级神经同步是通过尖峰神经元的微观动力学与振荡同步的宏观机制之间自下而上和自上而下的迭代相互作用而出现的。具体来说，我们将目标系统中的每个地块（例如，皮质区域或图像像素）建模为嵌入预定义连接支架中的尖峰神经元。低级信息被编码在时空域中，其中神经元被选择性地分组并通过自组织动力学随着时间的推移自发放电。在自下而上的路线中，振荡同步是由有限内存窗口上累积的过去尖峰活动形成的。由于大脑动力学在部分和瞬态同步而不是全局锁相的状态下运行，因此我们使用延时同步公式对振荡协调进行建模，这使得能够对大规模分布式系统的异构神经尖峰进行自上而下的调制。我们共同设计了一种同步脉冲神经网络 (S2-Net)，它使用有节奏的计时作为有效信息处理的控制机制。在广泛的任务中都取得了有希望的结果，包括神经活动解码、节能信号处理、时间绑定和语义推理。

papers.title: Robust volatility updates for Hierarchical Gaussian Filtering
papers.abstract: Hierarchical Gaussian Filtering (HGF) networks allow for efficient updating of posterior distributions (beliefs) about hidden states of an agent's environment. HGF parent nodes can target the mean or variance of their children. New information entering at input nodes leads to a cascade of belief updates across the network according to one-step update equations for each node's mean and precision (inverse variance). However, the original form of the update equations for variance-targeting parents(volatility coupling) can in some regions of parameter space lead to negative posterior precision, a logical impossibility which causes the updating algorithm to terminate with an error. In this report, we introduce a modified quadratic approximation to the variational energy of volatility-coupled nodes that avoids negative posterior precision. The key idea is to interpolate between two quadratic expansions of the variational energy: one at the prior prediction and one at a second mode whose location is obtained in closed form via the Lambert W function. The resulting update equations are robust across the entire parameter space and faithfully track the variational posterior even for large prediction errors.
papers.title_zh: 分层高斯过滤的稳健波动性更新
papers.abstract_zh: 分层高斯过滤 (HGF) 网络允许有效更新有关代理环境隐藏状态的后验分布（信念）。 HGF 父节点可以针对其子节点的均值或方差。在输入节点输入的新信息会根据每个节点均值和精度（逆方差）的一步更新方程导致整个网络中的一系列信念更新。然而，方差目标父项（波动性耦合）的更新方程的原始形式可能在参数空间的某些区域中导致负后验精度，这是逻辑上不可能的，导致更新算法因错误而终止。在本报告中，我们引入了对波动耦合节点的变分能量的修改二次近似，以避免负后验精度。关键思想是在变分能量的两个二次展开之间进行插值：一个在先前预测，一个在第二模式，其位置通过 Lambert W 函数以封闭形式获得。由此产生的更新方程在整个参数空间中都是稳健的，即使对于较大的预测误差也能忠实地跟踪变分后验。

papers.title: SIMON: Saliency-aware Integrative Multi-view Object-centric Neural Decoding
papers.abstract: Recent EEG-to-image retrieval methods leverage pretrained vision encoders and foveation-inspired priors, but typically assume a fixed, center-focused view. This center bias conflicts with content-driven human attention, creating a geometric-semantic dissociation between visual features and EEG responses. We propose SIMON, a saliency-aware multi-view framework for zero-shot EEG-to-image retrieval. SIMON combines foreground segmentation and saliency prediction to select fixation centers via Saliency-Aware Sampling (SAS), then generates foveated views that emphasize informative object regions while suppressing background clutter. On THINGS-EEG, SIMON achieves state-of-the-art performance in both intra-subject and inter-subject settings, reaching an average Top-1 accuracy of 69.7% and 19.6%, respectively, consistently outperforming recent competitive baselines. Analyses across sampling granularity, EEG channel topology, and visual/brain encoder backbones further support the robustness of saliency-aware multi-view integration. Our code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/simonlink666/SIMON.
papers.title_zh: SIMON：显着性感知集成多视图以对象为中心的神经解码
papers.abstract_zh: 最近的脑电图到图像检索方法利用预训练的视觉编码器和中心凹启发的先验，但通常假设固定的、中心聚焦的视图。这种中心偏差与内容驱动的人类注意力相冲突，在视觉特征和脑电图反应之间造成几何语义分离。我们提出了 SIMON，一种用于零样本脑电图到图像检索的显着性感知多视图框架。 SIMON 将前景分割和显着性预测相结合，通过显着性感知采样 (SAS) 选择注视中心，然后生成注视点视图，强调信息丰富的对象区域，同时抑制背景杂乱。在 THINGS-EEG 上，SIMON 在受试者内和受试者间设置中均实现了最先进的性能，平均 Top-1 准确度分别达到 69.7% 和 19.6%，始终优于最近的竞争基线。跨采样粒度、EEG 通道拓扑和视觉/大脑编码器主干的分析进一步支持显着性感知多视图集成的稳健性。我们的代码和模型可在 https://github.com/simonlink666/SIMON 上公开获取。

papers.title: Inferring Active Neural Circuits Using Diffusion Scores
papers.abstract: In biological systems, neural circuits compute through directed, short-latency interactions whose effects unfold across multiple time scales and behavioral contexts. We address the problem of inferring these local, lag-specific interactions from sampled neural population activity under varying stimuli, without assuming a parametric form for the underlying dynamics. Our approach leverages denoising score models by estimating joint-window scores over consecutive activity snapshots (i.e., brain states) and converting these scores into calibrated, directed edge tests via cross-block score products. The key insight is that these products recover the Jacobian of the transition map between brain states under nonlinear dynamics. To cleanly separate lag-specific effects, we introduce minimal multi-block windows that condition on intermediate time points, avoiding the omitted-lag bias inherent in pairwise analyses. The resulting method, Score--Block Time Graphs (SBTG), identifies lag-specific directed interactions in sampled neuronal population data. We specifically apply SBTG to whole-brain C. elegans calcium imaging data to recover lag-specific circuit structure not resolved by current methods, including improved alignment with independent connectomes, cell-type-specific temporal organization, and neuromodulatory profiles consistent with known receptor kinetics. These findings highlight the potential for SBTG to serve as a practical ``AI for science'' tool by turning high-dimensional neural population recordings into statistically testable circuit hypotheses.
papers.title_zh: 使用扩散分数推断活跃神经回路
papers.abstract_zh: 在生物系统中，神经回路通过定向的、短延迟的交互进行计算，其效果在多个时间尺度和行为环境中展开。我们解决了从不同刺激下采样的神经群体活动中推断这些局部的、滞后特定的相互作用的问题，而不假设潜在动态的参数形式。我们的方法通过估计连续活动快照（即大脑状态）的联合窗口分数并通过跨块分数产品将这些分数转换为校准的定向边缘测试来利用去噪分数模型。关键的见解是这些产品恢复了非线性动力学下大脑状态之间转换图的雅可比行列式。为了清楚地分离滞后特定效应，我们引入了以中间时间点为条件的最小多块窗口，避免了成对分析中固有的遗漏滞后偏差。由此产生的方法，分数-块时间图（SBTG），识别采样神经元群体数据中滞后特定的定向相互作用。我们特别将 SBTG 应用于全脑线虫钙成像数据，以恢复当前方法无法解决的滞后特异性电路结构，包括改进与独立连接组的对齐、细胞类型特异性时间组织以及与已知受体动力学一致的神经调节特征。这些发现凸显了 SBTG 通过将高维神经群体记录转化为统计上可检验的电路假设，作为实用的“科学人工智能”工具的潜力。

papers.title: Compound Attrition Games: A Unified Model for Inter- and Intra-Coalition Rivalry
papers.abstract: Strategic competitions in the real world, from wars to geopolitical rivalries, often involve coalitions competing against rival groups. These contests are not simple interactions between unified entities, but multilayered processes in which coalitions face external competition while dealing with internal conflicts over resources and strategy. Existing game-theoretic models typically treat inter-coalition rivalry and intra-coalition competition separately.   This paper introduces the Compound Coalition-Attrition Game (CCAG), a unified framework that integrates a war of attrition between coalitions with a simultaneous war of attrition within each coalition. In this model, the endurance of a coalition in external competition is determined by the strategic choices of its members, who compete internally for shares of the outcome.   We prove the nonexistence of pure-strategy equilibria and characterize the unique mixed-strategy Nash equilibrium. The analysis reveals feedback effects: external competition intensifies internal conflict, while internal discord weakens external performance.   A case study compares traditional commodity markets, including gold, copper, and silver, with cryptocurrency markets, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana, using data from 2018 to 2023 in a simulation framework. The results demonstrate applicability in industrial strategy, corporate decision-making, and geopolitical competition. The CCAG framework provides a tool for analysing complex strategic environments.
papers.title_zh: 复合消耗博弈：联盟间和联盟内竞争的统一模型
papers.abstract_zh: 现实世界中的战略竞争，从战争到地缘政治对抗，通常涉及联盟与敌对团体的竞争。这些竞争不是统一实体之间的简单互动，而是联盟面临外部竞争、同时处理内部资源和战略冲突的多层次过程。现有的博弈论模型通常分别处理联盟间竞争和联盟内竞争。   本文介绍了复合联盟消耗博弈（CCAG），这是一个统一的框架，它将联盟之间的消耗战与每个联盟内部同时发生的消耗战结合起来。在这个模型中，联盟在外部竞争中的持久力取决于其成员的战略选择，这些成员在内部竞争以分享结果。   我们证明了纯策略均衡的不存在，并描述了独特的混合策略纳什均衡。分析揭示了反馈效应：外部竞争加剧内部冲突，内部不和谐削弱外部绩效。   一项案例研究在模拟框架中使用 2018 年至 2023 年的数据，对黄金、铜和白银等传统商品市场与比特币、以太坊和 Solana 等加密货币市场进行了比较。结果证明了其在产业战略、企业决策和地缘政治竞争中的适用性。 CCAG 框架提供了分析复杂战略环境的工具。

papers.title: Modeling sequential cognitive states via population level cortical dynamics
papers.abstract: In this work, we present a mathematical model for cyclic and sequential patterns of brain activity, combining heteroclinic dynamics with discrete neural-field models. We first show that spatial-discrete neural-field equations with biologically realistic equilibria cannot support heteroclinic cycles. On the other hand, heterocline dynamics often arise in Lotka-Volterra-type systems, but these equations do not directly correspond to neuronal processes. To address this, we use a version of the Universal Approximation Theorem to approximate any target dynamics by a neural network interpretable as a high-dimensional Amari-type neural-field system. When the target dynamics contains a heteroclinic cycle, the approximating vector field generates a periodic trajectory that closely follows the heteroclinic connection. As a case study, we consider the cognitive processes underlying focused-attention meditation. We show how the model reproduces sequential transitions among cognitive states and we conclude providing a neural interpretation of the approximating dynamics.
papers.title_zh: 通过群体水平皮质动力学建模连续认知状态
papers.abstract_zh: In this work, we present a mathematical model for cyclic and sequential patterns of brain activity, combining heteroclinic dynamics with discrete neural-field models.我们首先表明，具有生物学现实平衡的空间离散神经场方程不能支持异宿循环。 On the other hand, heterocline dynamics often arise in Lotka-Volterra-type systems, but these equations do not directly correspond to neuronal processes. To address this, we use a version of the Universal Approximation Theorem to approximate any target dynamics by a neural network interpretable as a high-dimensional Amari-type neural-field system. When the target dynamics contains a heteroclinic cycle, the approximating vector field generates a periodic trajectory that closely follows the heteroclinic connection.作为一个案例研究，我们考虑了集中注意力冥想背后的认知过程。 We show how the model reproduces sequential transitions among cognitive states and we conclude providing a neural interpretation of the approximating dynamics.

papers.title: Simulating Infant First-Person Sensorimotor Experience via Motion Retargeting from Babies to Humanoids
papers.abstract: Motion retargeting from humans to human-like artificial agents is becoming increasingly important as humanoid robots grow more capable. However, most existing approaches focus only on reproducing kinematics and ignore the rich sensorimotor experience associated with human movement. In this work, we present a framework for simulating the multimodal sensorimotor experiences of infants using physical and virtual humanoids. From a single video, our method reconstructs the infant's body configuration by extracting its skeletal structure and estimating the full 3D pose from each frame. Then we map the reconstructed motion onto several developmental platforms: the physical iCub robot and the virtual simulators pyCub, EMFANT and MIMo. Replaying the retargeted motions on these embodiments produces simulated multisensory streams including proprioception (joints and muscles), touch, and vision. For the best-matching embodiment, the retargeting achieves sub-centimeter accuracy and enables a rich multimodal analysis of infant development as well as enhanced automated annotation of behaviors. This framework provides a unique window into the infant's sensorimotor experience, offering new tools for robotics, developmental science, and early detection of neurodevelopmental disorders. The code is available at https://github.com/ctu-vras/motion-retargeting/.
papers.title_zh: 通过从婴儿到类人动物的运动重定向来模拟婴儿第一人称感觉运动体验
papers.abstract_zh: 随着人形机器人能力的增强，从人类到类人机器人的运动重定向变得越来越重要。然而，大多数现有方法只关注再现运动学，而忽略了与人类运动相关的丰富的感觉运动体验。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个使用物理和虚拟人形机器人模拟婴儿多模式感觉运动体验的框架。我们的方法通过提取婴儿的骨骼结构并估计每帧的完整 3D 姿势，从单个视频中重建婴儿的身体配置。然后，我们将重建的运动映射到几个开发平台上：物理 iCub 机器人和虚拟模拟器 pyCub、EMFANT 和 MIMO。在这些实施例上重放重定向的运动产生模拟的多感官流，包括本体感觉（关节和肌肉）、触觉和视觉。对于最佳匹配的实施例，重定向实现了亚厘米精度，并实现了婴儿发育的丰富多模态分析以及增强的行为自动注释。该框架为了解婴儿的感觉运动体验提供了一个独特的窗口，为机器人学、发育科学和神经发育障碍的早期检测提供了新工具。该代码可在 https://github.com/ctu-vras/motion-retargeting/ 获取。

papers.title: The Short- and Long-Term Impacts of Expanding Public Education for Disabled Students
papers.abstract: Between 1949 and 1980, every U.S. state mandated public schools to provide educational services for disabled students. This is one of the largest education reforms in U.S. history, but little is known about its impacts. Given scarce data in this period, I compile survey and administrative datasets and set up a difference-in-difference design using variation in the mandates' timing. I show that the mandates increased both services for disabled students and preschool enrollments. In adulthood, disabled individuals below school age at a mandate's implementation became about 20% less likely to have no education, attained up to 0.23 more years of education, and were more likely to have worked. Although this policy could have taken away resources from non-disabled students, in fact, education and employment also increased for non-disabled individuals. These effects align with evidence that the mandates increased spending per student by up to 15%. Families were also impacted: the mandates increased employment among mothers of disabled children and the probability that disabled individuals became household heads. Over the long term, the mandates paid for themselves by generating government revenues in excess of their cost. These results provide new evidence on the large, broad impacts of expanding access to education for disabled students.
papers.title_zh: 扩大残疾学生公共教育的短期和长期影响
papers.abstract_zh: 1949 年至 1980 年间，美国各州都强制公立学校为残疾学生提供教育服务。这是美国历史上最大的教育改革之一，但对其影响却知之甚少。鉴于这一时期的数据稀缺，我编制了调查和行政数据集，并利用任务时间的变化建立了双重差异设计。我表明这些指令增加了对残疾学生的服务和学前教育的入学率。成年后，在强制执行时学龄以下的残疾人没有受过教育的可能性降低了约 20%，受教育年限增加了 0.23 年，并且更有可能参加工作。尽管这项政策可能会夺走非残疾学生的资源，但事实上，非残疾个人的教育和就业也有所增加。这些效果与这些规定使每个学生的支出增加了 15% 的证据相一致。家庭也受到影响：这些规定增加了残疾儿童母亲的就业以及残疾人成为户主的可能性。从长远来看，这些任务通过产生超过其成本的政府收入来收回成本。这些结果提供了新的证据，证明扩大残疾学生的教育机会会产生巨大而广泛的影响。

papers.title: Observable Performance Does Not Fully Reflect System Organization: A Multi-Level Analysis of Gait Dynamics Under Occlusal Constraint
papers.abstract: In biomechanical systems, observable performance is often used as a proxy for underlying system organization. However, this assumption implicitly presumes a correspondence between output metrics and internal system states that may not hold in adaptive systems. In this study, the vertical dimension of occlusion (VDO) is considered as a constraint applied to an adaptive neuromechanical system, enabling the exploration of system-level responses under controlled variations. A single-case design in a patient with Parkinson's disease allows an intra-individual analysis across repeated conditions.The analysis is structured across three complementary levels: (i) aggregated linear metrics describing observable performance, (ii) a dynamical systems framework describing temporal organization in state space, and (iii) a latent space representation obtained through unsupervised embedding. The results show that conditions with comparable observable performance may correspond to different organizations in both state space and latent space representations. This dissociation highlights a limitation of aggregated metrics and suggests that similar outputs may arise from non-equivalent system states. A fourth level is proposed as a purely conceptual extension describing potential relationships between system states. This level is not implemented and is not derived from experimental data. These observations are strictly exploratory and non-causal. The proposed framework does not establish mechanistic, predictive, or directional relationships, but provides a structured approach for analyzing constraint-driven systems across multiple levels of representation.
papers.title_zh: 可观察的性能并不能完全反映系统组织：咬合约束下步态动力学的多层次分析
papers.abstract_zh: 在生物力学系统中，可观察的性能通常用作底层系统组织的代理。然而，这种假设隐含地假定了输出度量和内部系统状态之间的对应关系，而这在自适应系统中可能不成立。在本研究中，遮挡的垂直维度（VDO）被认为是应用于自适应神经力学系统的约束，从而能够探索受控变化下的系统级响应。帕金森病患者的单病例设计允许在重复条件下进行个体内分析。该分析分为三个互补级别：(i) 描述可观察性能的聚合线性指标，(ii) 描述状态空间中的时间组织的动态系统框架，以及 (iii) 通过无监督嵌入获得的潜在空间表示。结果表明，具有可比较的可观察性能的条件可能对应于状态空间和潜在空间表示中的不同组织。这种分离凸显了聚合指标的局限性，并表明相似的输出可能来自不等效的系统状态。第四层被提议作为纯粹概念性的扩展，描述系统状态之间的潜在关系。该级别尚未实现，也不是从实验数据得出的。这些观察结果是严格的探索性和非因果性的。所提出的框架不建立机械的、预测的或方向的关系，而是提供一种结构化方法来分析跨多个表示级别的约束驱动系统。

papers.title: Electroencephalography and Electromyography as a Non-Invasive Biomarker of Neural Regeneration: A Review of Central and Peripheral Nervous System Injury and Regeneration
papers.abstract: Regeneration of the nervous system after injury remains an important therapeutic objective, especially in the central nervous system (CNS), in which regeneration is restricted by both neuronal limitations as well as adverse extracellular environments. Conversely, the peripheral nervous system (PNS) displays enhanced regenerative capability in the presence of supportive Schwann cells (SC) and pro-growth stimuli. While the structure and molecular mechanisms are thoroughly understood, functional biomarkers that can non-invasively monitor regeneration in real time are limited. In this review, we discuss the promise of electroencephalography (EEG) as well as electromyography (EMG) as real-time, non-invasive biomarkers to monitor damage to nerves and regeneration in both CNS and PNS contexts.   First, we contrast biological and electrophysiological indicators of CNS/PNS injury, showing how EEG signs, including oscillatory power, connectivity, and evoked potential changes, reflect dysfunction due to injury as well as neuroplastic reorganization. Also, EMG provides direct insight into muscle activation and peripheral output, providing useful EEG complementation in neuromuscular pathway integrity and reactivation. In CNS injuries (e.g., stroke, spinal cord injury (SCI)), EEG typically shows global slowing, disrupted interhemispheric coherence, and partial recovery of higher frequencies. For PNS injuries, EEG can capture cortical remapping and return of somatosensory evoked responses with re-establishment of the peripheries' connectivity. EMG, in turn, enables monitoring of reinnervation and restoration of functional motor output.   This review presents a dual-system perspective, positioning EEG and EMG not only as diagnostic tools but also as functional biomarkers of neural regeneration, thereby bridging electrophysiology, plasticity, and clinical recovery.
papers.title_zh: 脑电图和肌电图作为神经再生的非侵入性生物标志物：中枢和周围神经系统损伤和再生的回顾
papers.abstract_zh: 损伤后神经系统的再生仍然是一个重要的治疗目标，特别是在中枢神经系统（CNS）中，其中再生受到神经元限制和不利的细胞外环境的限制。相反，周围神经系统（PNS）在支持性雪旺细胞（SC）和促生长刺激的存在下表现出增强的再生能力。虽然结构和分子机制已被彻底了解，但能够非侵入性实时监测再生的功能生物标志物仍然有限。在这篇综述中，我们讨论了脑电图 (EEG) 和肌电图 (EMG) 作为实时、非侵入性生物标志物监测 CNS 和 PNS 环境中神经损伤和再生的前景。   首先，我们对比 CNS/PNS 损伤的生物和电生理指标，显示 EEG 信号（包括振荡功率、连通性和诱发电位变化）如何反映损伤导致的功能障碍以及神经可塑性重组。此外，肌电图可以直接洞察肌肉激活和外周输出，为神经肌肉通路的完整性和重新激活提供有用的脑电图补充。在中枢神经系统损伤（例如中风、脊髓损伤 (SCI)）中，脑电图通常显示整体减慢、半球间一致性破坏以及较高频率的部分恢复。对于 PNS 损伤，脑电图可以通过重建外周连接来捕获皮质重新映射和体感诱发反应的返回。肌电图反过来又可以监测神经支配和功能性运动输出恢复。   本综述提出了双系统视角，将脑电图和肌电图不仅定位为诊断工具，而且定位为神经再生的功能性生物标志物，从而在电生理学、可塑性和临床恢复之间架起桥梁。

papers.title: What Jobs Can AI Learn? Measuring Exposure by Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Which jobs can AI learn to do? We examine this for every occupation in the US economy. Existing indices measure the overlap between AI capabilities and occupational tasks rather than which tasks AI systems can learn to perform, and as a result misclassify occupations where the gap between present capability and learnability is large. Reinforcement learning in post-training, now the dominant paradigm at the frontier, is structured around task completion and maps more directly onto the task-based architecture of occupational classifications than prior approaches. Using LLM annotators guided by a rubric developed with RL experts and validated against confirmed deployment cases, we score all 17,951 ONET tasks for training feasibility and aggregate to the occupation level, producing an RL Feasibility Index. The index diverges sharply from existing AI exposure measures for specific occupation groups: power plant operators, railroad conductors, and aircraft cargo handling supervisors score high on RL feasibility but low on general AI exposure, while creative and interpersonal roles (musicians, physicians, natural sciences managers) show the reverse. These divergences carry direct implications for policy interventions.
papers.title_zh: AI可以学习哪些工作？通过强化学习测量暴露程度
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能可以学习哪些工作？我们对美国经济中的每一个职业都进行了研究。现有的指数衡量的是人工智能能力和职业任务之间的重叠，而不是人工智能系统可以学习执行哪些任务，从而对现有能力和可学习性之间差距较大的职业进行错误分类。培训后的强化学习现在是前沿的主导范式，它是围绕任务完成而构建的，并且比以前的方法更直接地映射到基于任务的职业分类架构。使用以 RL 专家开发的标题为指导并根据已确认的部署案例进行验证的 LLM 注释器，我们对所有 17,951 个 ONET 任务进行培训可行性评分，并汇总到职业级别，生成 RL 可行性指数。该指数与针对特定职业群体的现有人工智能暴露衡量标准存在很大差异：发电厂操作员、铁路售票员和飞机货物装卸主管在强化学习可行性方面得分较高，但在一般人工智能暴露方面得分较低，而创造性和人际角色（音乐家、医生、自然科学经理）则表现出相反的情况。这些分歧对政策干预有直接影响。

papers.title: Optimal Consumption and Investment with Energy-Efficiency Adoption
papers.abstract: Despite many decades of research, economically grounded models that analyse energy consumption and energy-efficiency adoption within a unified framework remain underdeveloped. This article addresses this gap by proposing a model of consumption, investment, and energy-efficiency adoption under uncertainty. It develops new definitions of the rebound and backfire effects, and integrates their welfare implications into a model of optimal subsidy design. Macro-level technology diffusion and energy consumption across heterogeneous agents are also formalised. Explicit results for core objects are derived, including the adoption threshold and post-adoption strategies, and these are shown to depend on agent wealth, introducing a novel channel through which financial conditions influence technology-adoption decisions. An approximation scheme is proposed to estimate welfare implications explicitly. Adoption of energy efficiency is shown to be welfare improving in the main. A detailed case study of a representative German single-family home illustrates the theoretical results. Numerical analysis indicates that the subsidy policy effectively steers aggregate energy consumption.
papers.title_zh: 通过提高能源效率实现最佳消费和投资
papers.abstract_zh: 尽管进行了数十年的研究，但在统一框架内分析能源消耗和能源效率采用的经济基础模型仍然不发达。本文通过提出不确定性下的消费、投资和能源效率采用模型来解决这一差距。它对反弹和适得其反效应提出了新的定义，并将其福利影响纳入最优补贴设计模型中。宏观层面的技术扩散和跨异构主体的能源消耗也已正式化。得出了核心对象的明确结果，包括采用门槛和采用后策略，这些结果被证明取决于代理人的财富，引入了财务状况影响技术采用决策的新渠道。提出了一种近似方案来明确估计福利影响。事实证明，采用能源效率主要可以改善福利。对德国代表性单户住宅的详细案例研究说明了理论结果。数值分析表明，补贴政策有效引导能源消费总量。

papers.title: Multisensory learning recruits visual neurons into an olfactory memory engram
papers.abstract: Associating multiple sensory cues with a single experience or object is a fundamental process that improves object recognition and memory performance. However, neural mechanisms that bind sensory features during learning and augment memory expression are unknown. Here we demonstrate multisensory appetitive and aversive memory in Drosophila. Combining colours and odours improved memory performance, even when each sensory modality was tested alone. Temporal control of neuronal function revealed visually-selective mushroom body Kenyon Cells (KCs) to be required for enhancement of visual and olfactory memory recall after multisensory training. Synapse-level connectomics suggests that valence-relevant dopaminergic reinforcement could permit the KC-spanning serotonergic DPM neurons to bridge between previously modality-selective KC streams. Consistent with this model, DPM transmission is uniquely required during multisensory memory formation and for enhanced expression of olfactory memory afterwards. In addition, signalling via the DopR1 dopamine receptor is required in APL neurons, suggesting that reinforcing dopamine could locally release GABA-ergic inhibition to permit bridging microcircuits to function. Cross-modal binding thereby expands the KCs representing the olfactory memory engram into those representing the colour. We propose that broadening of the engram improves memory performance after multisensory learning and permits a single sensory feature to retrieve the memory of the multimodal experience.
papers.title_zh: 多感官学习将视觉神经元招募到嗅觉记忆印迹中
papers.abstract_zh: 将多种感官线索与单一体验或物体相关联是提高物体识别和记忆性能的基本过程。然而，在学习过程中结合感觉特征和增强记忆表达的神经机制尚不清楚。在这里，我们展示了果蝇的多感官食欲和厌恶记忆。即使单独测试每种感官模式，颜色和气味的结合也能提高记忆性能。神经元功能的时间控制揭示了视觉选择性蘑菇体凯尼恩细胞（KC）是多感官训练后增强视觉和嗅觉记忆回忆所必需的。突触级连接组学表明，价相关的多巴胺能强化可以允许 KC 跨越血清素能 DPM 神经元在先前模态选择性 KC 流之间建立桥梁。与该模型一致，DPM 传输是多感觉记忆形成过程中以及之后嗅觉记忆增强表达所必需的。此外，APL 神经元需要通过 DopR1 多巴胺受体发出信号，这表明增强多巴胺可以局部释放 GABA 能抑制，从而允许桥接微电路发挥作用。因此，跨模式结合将代表嗅觉记忆印迹的 KC 扩展为代表颜色的 KC。我们建议，印迹的拓宽可以提高多感官学习后的记忆性能，并允许单个感官特征检索多模态体验的记忆。

papers.title: The Rise of Negative Earnings and Demand Shifting Investment
papers.abstract: We document the rise of negative earnings between 1980 and 2019: a secular increase in the percent of firms reporting losses, both among public firms and in the broader universe of US corporations, and a secular increase in the persistence of losses year-to-year among public firms. This rise has occurred alongside a spreading of the sales and earnings distribution and a recomposition of firm spending away from production costs and traditional investment and towards sales general and administrative expenses. We rationalize these phenomena with a model of heterogenous firms engaging in supply and demand shifting investment. Our model includes a scale elasticity of demand determining the relationship between the intensive margin of demand (demand per customer) and the extensive margin of demand (number of customers). We are able to quantitatively match the rise in reported losses and qualitatively match (1) the increased persistence of losses, (2) the spreading of the sales and earning distribution and (3) the recomposition of firm spending with this parameter as the single driver of changes across steady state equilibria. The rise in the scale elasticity associated with the increase in reported losses has non-trivial aggregate implications: in our model it lowers GDP by -9.1% by reallocating labor away from goods and capital production and reallocating demand away from productive firms.
papers.title_zh: 负收益的增加和需求转移投资
papers.abstract_zh: 我们记录了 1980 年至 2019 年间负收益的增加：无论是在上市公司还是在更广泛的美国公司中，报告亏损的公司百分比都在长期增加，而且上市公司每年持续亏损的情况也在长期增加。这种增长是伴随着销售和收益分配的扩大以及公司支出从生产成本和传统投资转向销售一般和管理费用的重组而发生的。我们通过参与供需转移投资的异质公司模型来合理化这些现象。我们的模型包括需求规模弹性，决定集约需求边际（每个客户的需求）和扩展需求边际（客户数量）之间的关系。我们能够定量地匹配报告损失的增长，并定性地匹配（1）损失持续性的增加，（2）销售和收益分配的扩散，以及（3）公司支出的重组，将此参数作为稳态均衡变化的单一驱动因素。与报告损失增加相关的规模弹性的上升具有重要的总体影响：在我们的模型中，它通过将劳动力从商品和资本生产中重新分配以及将需求从生产性企业中重新分配出来，使GDP降低了-9.1%。

papers.title: A geometry aware framework enhances noninvasive mapping of whole human brain dynamics
papers.abstract: Non-invasive electrophysiology lacks methods that accurately reconstruct whole-brain spatiotemporal dynamics while incorporating individual cortical geometry, leaving current electroencephalography and magnetoencephalography source imaging limited by simplistic or biologically implausible priors. Here, we show that embedding participant-specific Geometric Basis Functions (GBFs), eigenmodes derived from each individual's cortical surface, provides a powerful anatomic constraint that resolves the inverse problem and improves reconstruction fidelity. The method reconstructs neural sources as linear combinations of geometric basis functions, thereby aligning source estimates with the geometric organization of neural dynamics. We validate GBF across the Meta-Source Benchmark, task-evoked data, resting-state networks, intracranial stimulation, and epilepsy data. The results demonstrate that GBF yields high localization accuracy and captures fast spatiotemporal dynamics consistent with anatomical pathways. These findings suggest that both spontaneous and evoked whole-brain activity can be described by hundreds of geometric modes, providing a compact yet accurate representation of neural sources. By linking cortical geometry to electrophysiological dynamics, GBF offers a versatile source imaging tool for both scientific and clinical applications.
papers.title_zh: 几何感知框架增强了整个人脑动力学的无创映射
papers.abstract_zh: 非侵入性电生理学缺乏准确重建全脑时空动力学同时结合个体皮质几何形状的方法，使得当前的脑电图和脑磁图源成像受到简单化或生物学上不可信的先验的限制。在这里，我们展示了嵌入参与者特定的几何基础函数（GBF），即从每个个体的皮质表面导出的本征模式，提供了强大的解剖学约束，可以解决逆问题并提高重建保真度。该方法将神经源重建为几何基函数的线性组合，从而使源估计与神经动力学的几何组织保持一致。我们通过元源基准、任务诱发数据、静息状态网络、颅内刺激和癫痫数据来验证 GBF。结果表明，GBF 具有较高的定位精度，并捕获与解剖路径一致的快速时空动态。这些发现表明，自发的和诱发的全脑活动都可以通过数百种几何模式来描述，从而提供神经源的紧凑而准确的表示。通过将皮质几何学与电生理动力学联系起来，GBF 为科学和临床应用提供了多功能源成像工具。

papers.title: General-Purpose Technology and Speculative Bubble Detection
papers.abstract: We show that the leading bubble test suffers severe size distortion when fundamentals incorporate general-purpose technology adoption. Embedding a hump-shaped technology shock in the Campbell-Shiller present-value model, we prove that the fundamental price becomes locally explosive during adoption, contaminating the test's limit distribution with a non-centrality parameter proportional to the shock's peak. We propose a fundamental-versus-speculative decomposition that projects prices onto observable technology proxies and applies the test to the residual. Empirically, the decomposition eliminates evidence of speculation in the 2020-2025 AI rally while confirming a speculative peak confined to December 1999-March 2000 in the dot-com episode.
papers.title_zh: 通用技术和投机性泡沫检测
papers.abstract_zh: 我们表明，当基本原理与通用技术采用相结合时，领先的气泡测试会遭受严重的尺寸扭曲。在坎贝尔-席勒现值模型中嵌入驼峰形技术冲击，我们证明基本价格在采用过程中会局部爆炸，从而用与冲击峰值成比例的非中心参数污染了测试的极限分布。我们提出了一种基本面与投机性的分解，将价格投射到可观察的技术代理上，并将测试应用于残差。从经验上看，这种分解消除了 2020 年至 2025 年人工智能反弹的投机证据，同时确认了互联网泡沫时期的投机峰值仅限于 1999 年 12 月至 2000 年 3 月。

papers.title: Electricity price forecasting across Norway's five bidding zones in the post-crisis era
papers.abstract: Norway's electricity market is heavily dominated by hydropower, but the 2021--2022 energy crisis and stronger integration with Continental Europe have fundamentally altered price formation, reducing the reliability of forecasting models calibrated on historical data. Despite the critical need for updated models, a unified benchmark evaluating feature contributions across all structurally diverse Norwegian bidding zones remains lacking. Here we present a comprehensive evaluation of electricity price forecasting across all five Norwegian Nord Pool bidding zones. We constructed a multimodal hourly dataset spanning 2019--2025 and evaluated eight forecasting model families including LightGBM, ARX, and advanced deep learning architectures using a strictly causal test set. We implemented robust rolling-origin backtesting, leave-one-group-out feature ablation, and conditional regime analysis to dissect model performance and feature utility. Our results show that LightGBM achieves the best performance in every zone with MAE ranging from 1.64 to 5.74~EUR/MWh, while the ridge ARX model remains a highly competitive linear benchmark in northern zones. Feature ablation reveals that models relying solely on lagged prices and calendar variables achieve high accuracy and often match or exceed full multimodal integration. However, conditional regime analysis demonstrates that external features like reservoir levels and gas prices remain crucial to stratify forecast errors, which consistently increase under stressed market regimes. This highlights the practical value of model interpretability and regime awareness for decision makers facing structural changes in market dynamics.
papers.title_zh: 后危机时代挪威五个竞价区的电价预测
papers.abstract_zh: 挪威的电力市场主要以水电为主，但2021--2022年的能源危机以及与欧洲大陆的更紧密一体化从根本上改变了价格形成，降低了根据历史数据校准的预测模型的可靠性。尽管迫切需要更新模型，但仍然缺乏评估所有结构多样化的挪威投标区的功能贡献的统一基准。在这里，我们对所有五个挪威 Nord Pool 竞标区的电价预测进行了综合评估。我们构建了一个涵盖 2019--2025 年的多模式每小时数据集，并使用严格的因果测试集评估了八个预测模型系列，包括 LightGBM、ARX 和高级深度学习架构。我们实施了稳健的滚动原点回测、留一组特征消融和条件机制分析来剖析模型性能和特征效用。我们的结果表明，LightGBM 在每个区域都实现了最佳性能，MAE 范围为 1.64 至 5.74~EUR/MWh，而 ridge ARX 模型在北部区域仍然是极具竞争力的线性基准。特征消融表明，仅依赖滞后价格和日历变量的模型可以实现高精度，并且通常可以匹配或超过完整的多模式集成。然而，条件制度分析表明，水库水位和天然气价格等外部特征对于分层预测误差仍然至关重要，这些误差在压力市场制度下持续增加。这凸显了模型可解释性和制度意识对于面临市场动态结构性变化的决策者的实用价值。

papers.title: Measuring Understanding Through Discrete Compositional Knowledge Structures in Hierarchical Automata
papers.abstract: How do we measure genuine understanding in artificial cognitive systems? Current approaches face a measurement gap: probabilistic systems refine confidence gradually, practice-based systems compile knowledge through repeated execution, and neural systems distribute understanding across opaque embedding spaces. We propose that making understanding measurable requires architectures where understanding formation produces discrete, inspectable structural signatures. This paper presents hierarchical automata built from finite state machines representing patterns and higher-order automata representing compositions. Constrained inference constructs automata from single observations. Similarity detection clusters related automata, making concept robustness quantifiable. Graph memory makes compositional knowledge directly inspectable. Metacognitive mechanisms enable observable reconfiguration. We demonstrate understanding measurement in a simple geometric domain. Graph evolution tracking reveals five measurable signatures: immediate representation formation, structural knowledge, generalization capacity, compositional awareness, and metacognitive access. These measurements distinguish structural understanding from statistical correlation. Our contribution is a framework for making understanding measurable through discrete compositional knowledge structures. This measurement capability complements perceptual learning in neural systems and task execution in neurosymbolic architectures.
papers.title_zh: 通过分层自动机中的离散组合知识结构来衡量理解
papers.abstract_zh: 我们如何衡量人工认知系统的真正理解？当前的方法面临着测量差距：概率系统逐渐完善信心，基于实践的系统通过重复执行来编译知识，神经系统在不透明的嵌入空间中分配理解。我们建议，要使理解可测量，需要一种架构，其中理解形成可以产生离散的、可检查的结构特征。本文提出了由表示模式的有限状态机和表示组合的高阶自动机构建的分层自动机。约束推理根据单个观察构建自动机。相似性检测对相关自动机进行聚类，使概念的鲁棒性可量化。图存储器使组合知识可以直接检查。元认知机制可以实现可观察的重新配置。我们展示了对简单几何域中测量的理解。图演化跟踪揭示了五个可测量的特征：即时表示形成、结构知识、泛化能力、组成意识和元认知访问。这些测量将结构理解与统计相关性区分开来。我们的贡献是一个框架，可以通过离散的组合知识结构来衡量理解。这种测量能力补充了神经系统中的感知学习和神经符号架构中的任务执行。

papers.title: The Reservation Inflation of Hard Money: Gold-Standard Deflation and the Real Expansion of Nominal Claims, 1873-1896
papers.abstract: The original SCR theory proposed that inflation has two distinct expressions: circulation inflation, measured by rising transaction prices, and reservation inflation, measured by the rising real weight of monetary symbols, debt contracts, reserve claims, and other nominal stores of value relative to physical goods. A companion Japan paper tested one side of this theory by showing that, after money entered a reserve-dominant phase, monetary-base expansion no longer translated strongly into consumer-price inflation. This paper tests the other side of SCR: whether reservation inflation can arise when monetary issuance is constrained and circulation inflation is absent. The classical gold-standard deflation of 1873-1896 provides a clean historical setting. Using long-run British retail price data and the Minneapolis Fed historical U.S. CPI series, I show that the price level declined in both economies. Between 1873 and 1896, Britain's price index fell from 18.0 to 14.7, while the U.S. historical CPI fell from 36.0 to 25.0. Yet this deflation mechanically increased the real value of fixed nominal claims. A fixed-claim reservation index rose by 22.4% in Britain and 44.0% in the United States. Thus, the episode combines negative circulation inflation with positive reservation inflation. The result suggests that hard money does not abolish inflationary pressure in the SCR sense; it changes its domain of expression. Together with the Japan case, this paper supports a phase-dependent view of inflation in which CPI is only one observable expression of the monetary-material asymmetry.
papers.title_zh: 硬通货的储备通货膨胀：金本位通货紧缩和名义债权的实际扩张，1873-1896
papers.abstract_zh: 最初的 SCR 理论提出，通货膨胀有两种不同的表现形式：流通通货膨胀（以交易价格上涨来衡量）和储备通货膨胀（以货币符号、债务合同、储备债权和其他相对于实物商品的名义价值储存的实际权重上升来衡量）。日本的一篇同行论文测试了这一理论的一个方面，表明在货币进入储备主导阶段后，货币基础扩张不再强烈转化为消费者价格通胀。本文测试了SCR的另一面：在货币发行受到限制、流通通胀不存在的情况下，是否会出现储备通胀。 1873 年至 1896 年的经典金本位通货紧缩提供了干净的历史背景。我使用英国长期零售价格数据和明尼阿波利斯联储的美国历史消费者物价指数系列数据显示，两个经济体的价格水平均有所下降。 1873年至1896年间，英国的物价指数从18.0下降到14.7，而美国的历史CPI从36.0下降到25.0。然而，这种通货紧缩机械地增加了固定名义债权的实际价值。英国的固定索赔保留指数上涨了 22.4%，美国上涨了 44.0%。因此，这一事件将负流通通胀与正储备通胀结合起来。结果表明，硬通货并不能消除 SCR 意义上的通胀压力；它改变了它的表达域。结合日本的案例，本文支持通货膨胀的阶段相关观点，其中 CPI 只是货币与物质不对称的一种可观察的表达。

papers.title: Urban Science Beyond Samples: Up-to-Date Street Network Models and Indicators for Every Urban Area in the World
papers.abstract: Urban planners need up-to-date, global, and consistent street network models and indicators to measure resilience and performance, model accessibility, and target local quality-of-life interventions. This article presents up-to-date street network models and indicators for every urban area in the world. It uses 2025 urban area boundaries from the Global Human Settlement Layer, allowing users to join these data to hundreds of other urban attributes. Its workflow ingests 180 million OpenStreetMap nodes and 360 million OpenStreetMap edges across 10,351 urban areas in 189 countries. The code, models, and indicators are publicly available for reuse. These resources unlock worldwide urban street network science beyond samples as well as local analyses in under-resourced regions where models and indicators are otherwise less-accessible.
papers.title_zh: 超越样本的城市科学：世界每个城市地区的最新街道网络模型和指标
papers.abstract_zh: 城市规划者需要最新的、全球性的、一致的街道网络模型和指标来衡量弹性和绩效、建模可达性并针对当地生活质量干预措施。本文介绍了世界上每个城市地区的最新街道网络模型和指标。它使用全球人类住区图层中的 2025 年城市区域边界，允许用户将这些数据连接到数百个其他城市属性。其工作流程摄取了 189 个国家/地区 10,351 个城市地区的 1.8 亿个 OpenStreetMap 节点和 3.6 亿个 OpenStreetMap 边缘。代码、模型和指标可公开供重复使用。这些资源解锁了全球城市街道网络科学，超越了样本以及资源贫乏地区的本地分析，否则模型和指标很难获得。

papers.title: RSDM: The Consensus Honest Money in the AI Era
papers.abstract: The medium of exchange of the traditional economy is mainly the fiat currency of each country or region, and when cross-border transactions occur, they need to be settled according to the exchange rate. In the AI world, however, the medium of exchange tends to be a globally recognized currency. Especially when AI acts as an agent for cross-border capital pool and cross cyclical asset allocation, it needs a sound money that can resist the depreciation of fiat currency and store long-term value. Therefore, we propose a globally consensus and universally accepted monetary rule framework for the AI era. The devaluation of money runs through almost the whole process of history, from the weight reduction and purity decrease of metallic coin to the unanchored over-issuance of paper currency. Whether it is the periodic compulsory recoinage in medieval Europe or Gesell's stamp scrip, both are essentially mechanisms for taxing money holdings. Unlike Gesell's stamp scrip, Redeemable Self-Decaying/Devaluing Money (RSDM) is a tokenized commodity money. Its essential innovation is to fill the hole in the storage fee of metal coins through the self-devaluing of metal weight recorded on the deposit certificate (warehouse receipt) of metal coins. In a sense, RSDM is an innovative version of Jiaozi (a deposit receipt for base metal coin that emerged in Sichuan, China, about a thousand years ago). In this paper, we propose five forms of online and offline issuance of RSDM, providing a prototype for creating a globally recognized modern honest money.
papers.title_zh: RSDM：AI时代诚实货币的共识
papers.abstract_zh: 传统经济的交换媒介主要是各个国家或地区的法定货币，当发生跨境交易时，需要根据汇率进行结算。然而，在人工智能世界中，交换媒介往往是全球认可的货币。尤其是当人工智能充当跨境资金池和跨周期资产配置的代理人时，需要一种能够抵抗法币贬值并储存长期价值的稳健货币。因此，我们提出了一个全球共识、普遍接受的人工智能时代货币规则框架。货币贬值几乎贯穿了整个历史过程，从金属币的重量减轻、纯度下降，到纸币的无锚超发。无论是中世纪欧洲的定期强制重铸，还是格塞尔的邮票，本质上都是对货币持有征税的机制。与格塞尔的邮票不同，可赎回自腐烂/贬值货币（RSDM）是一种代币化的商品货币。其本质创新是通过金属币存单（仓单）上记录的金属重量自贬值来填补金属币保管费的缺口。从某种意义上说，RSDM是交子（大约一千年前在中国四川出现的一种贱金属硬币的存单）的创新版本。在本文中，我们提出了RSDM的五种线上和线下发行形式，为创建全球认可的现代诚实货币提供了原型。

papers.title: Sources of Inequality at Birth: The Interplay Between Genes and Parental Socioeconomic Status
papers.abstract: The start of a human's life can be characterized by two lotteries: that of your genes (nature) and the family you were born into (nurture). These set in motion a trajectory, from birth onward, in health and human capital. Leveraging three longitudinal social-science data sets, we systematically analyze the relationship between an individual's genotype, the socioeconomic status (SES) of the families they grew up in, and their realized traits in adulthood. We proxy an individual's genetic predisposition by polygenic indexes (PGIs) and family SES by a latent factor of parental education and father's (former) occupational status. We then investigate how PGIs, parental SES, and their interaction contribute to later-life outcomes across a range of forty-five socioeconomic, anthropometric, health, behavioral, and personality traits. We find strong genetic and socioeconomic associations with these phenotypes, but no evidence of sizable gene-environment interactions.
papers.title_zh: 出生时不平等的根源：基因与父母社会经济地位之间的相互作用
papers.abstract_zh: 人类生命的开始可以通过两种彩票来表征：你的基因（先天）和你出生的家庭（后天）。这些因素从出生起就开启了健康和人力资本的轨迹。利用三个纵向社会科学数据集，我们系统地分析了个体的基因型、他们成长的家庭的社会经济地位（SES）以及他们在成年后意识到的特征之间的关系。我们通过多基因指数（PGI）来代理个体的遗传倾向，并通过父母教育和父亲（前）职业地位的潜在因素来代理家庭社会经济地位。然后，我们研究 PGI、父母 SES 及其相互作用如何影响 45 种社会经济、人体测量、健康、行为和人格特征的晚年生活结果。我们发现这些表型与遗传和社会经济有很强的关联，但没有证据表明存在相当大的基因-环境相互作用。

papers.title: On Agentic Behavioral Modeling
papers.abstract: Integrating theoretical neuroscience, decision theory, and probabilistic inference offers a promising route to understanding human cognition, yet concrete methodological bridges between agentic AI models and behavioral data analysis remain formally underdeveloped. We advance this synthesis under the framework of agentic behavioral modeling (ABM), which treats artificial agents as latent, generative hypotheses about cognitive mechanisms and evaluates them by their statistical adequacy in explaining human behavior. After outlining its conceptual foundations, we apply the framework to two minimal laboratory paradigms: a binary perceptual contrast-discrimination task and a symmetric two-armed bandit learning task. We formalize each task-agent-data system as a joint probability model, derive explicit conditional log-likelihoods for behavioral inference, validate different model variants using model and parameter recovery simulations, and evaluate them in light of empirical data. Using these minimal examples, we provide an agent-centric interpretation of the psychometric function, derive optimal policies for both tasks, and show the equivalence between Rescorla-Wagner learning and Bayesian inference in symmetric bandits. More broadly, this work may serve as a conceptual and practical foundation for applying ABM to cognitive behavioral science.
papers.title_zh: 论主体行为建模
papers.abstract_zh: 理论神经科学、决策理论和概率推理的结合为理解人类认知提供了一条有前途的途径，但代理人工智能模型和行为数据分析之间的具体方法论桥梁在形式上仍然不发达。我们在代理行为模型（ABM）的框架下推进了这种综合，该模型将人工代理视为关于认知机制的潜在生成假设，并通过其解释人类行为的统计充分性来评估它们。在概述其概念基础之后，我们将该框架应用于两个最小的实验室范例：二元感知对比辨别任务和对称双臂老虎机学习任务。我们将每个任务代理数据系统形式化为联合概率模型，导出用于行为推理的明确条件对数似然，使用模型和参数恢复模拟验证不同的模型变体，并根据经验数据对其进行评估。使用这些最小的例子，我们提供了对心理测量函数的以代理为中心的解释，得出这两项任务的最佳策略，并展示了 Rescorla-Wagner 学习和对称强盗中的贝叶斯推理之间的等价性。更广泛地说，这项工作可以作为将 ABM 应用到认知行为科学的概念和实践基础。

papers.title: Functional Connectivity-Guided Band Selection for Motor Imagery Brain-Computer Interfaces
papers.abstract: Reliable control in motor imagery brain-computer interfaces (MI-BCIs) requires the precise decoding of user-specific neural rhythms, which vary significantly across individuals. The Common Spatial Pattern (CSP) algorithm is a cornerstone of MI-BCI decoding, yet its performance depends strongly on the spectral range of the input EEG data. Although Filter Bank CSP (FBCSP) extends this as a data-driven decoding framework, its frequency sub-bands are predefined rather than selected using subject-specific physiological criteria. This paper presents a proof-of-concept study of static functional connectivity (FC)-guided band selection for MI-BCI, demonstrated using a conventional FBCSP-based pipeline. The proposed method identifies the most discriminative spectral bands by calculating phase-based connectivity across four sensorimotor channels using wPLI, PLV, and PLI. Nine bands in a 4-40 Hz filter bank are ranked by the effect size of their hemispheric coupling differences and pruned to the top K bands for feature extraction and classification via FBCSP and a Support Vector Regressor. This framework was tested for K values ranging from 1 to 8 across the BCI Competition IV-2a (n = 9) and OpenBMI (n = 54) datasets. Performance was benchmarked against standard nine-band FBCSP and random ablation to determine the minimum number of bands (K*) required to maintain accuracy within a 2% baseline equivalence zone. Results show FC-guided selection can outperform random ablation and achieve near-baseline performance while reducing required CSP fits by 22.2% to 77.8%. PLV enables the most aggressive dimensionality reduction by prioritizing the μ and low-\b{eta} ranges, while wPLI demonstrates superior inter-session robustness by mitigating volume conduction. These findings establish FC-guided selection as a principled and interpretable alternative to heuristic filter bank designs.
papers.title_zh: 运动想象脑机接口的功能连接引导频段选择
papers.abstract_zh: 运动想象脑机接口 (MI-BCIs) 的可靠控制需要精确解码用户特定的神经节律，而神经节律因人而异。通用空间模式 (CSP) 算法是 MI-BCI 解码的基石，但其性能在很大程度上取决于输入 EEG 数据的频谱范围。尽管滤波器组 CSP (FBCSP) 将其扩展为数据驱动的解码框架，但其频率子带是预定义的，而不是使用特定于受试者的生理标准进行选择。本文提出了静态功能连接 (FC) 引导的 MI-BCI 频段选择的概念验证研究，并使用传统的基于 FBCSP 的管道进行了演示。所提出的方法通过使用 wPLI、PLV 和 PLI 计算四个感觉运动通道之间基于相位的连接来识别最具辨别力的光谱带。 4-40 Hz 滤波器组中的 9 个频段根据其半球耦合差异的影响大小进行排名，并修剪到前 K 个频段，以便通过 FBCSP 和支持向量回归器进行特征提取和分类。该框架在 BCI 竞赛 IV-2a (n = 9) 和 OpenBMI (n = 54) 数据集上测试了 1 到 8 范围内的 K 值。根据标准九波段 FBCSP 和随机消融对性能进行基准测试，以确定将精度保持在 2% 基线等效区内所需的最小波段数 (K*)。结果表明，FC 引导选择可以优于随机消融并实现接近基线的性能，同时将所需的 CSP 配合减少 22.2% 至 77.8%。 PLV 通过优先考虑 μ 和低 b{eta} 范围来实现最积极的降维，而 wPLI 通过减轻体积传导来展示卓越的会话间鲁棒性。这些发现将 FC 引导选择确立为启发式滤波器组设计的有原则且可解释的替代方案。

papers.title: Intrinsic Brain Networks Underlying the Experience and Expression of Subclinical Anxiety
papers.abstract: Anxiety includes behavioural, physiological, and subjective components that do not always align, and it remains unclear whether these dimensions are supported by distinct intrinsic brain networks. Guided by the two-system framework, we tested whether resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) differentiates these components in subclinical anxiety. Forty-seven young adults spanning a range of subclinical anxiety levels completed a threat anticipation task measuring behavioral responses (reaction time) and physiological arousal (skin conductance), along with the NIH Fear-Affect self-report of anxiety severity. These measures were related to rsFC using region-of-interest analyses. Higher subclinical anxiety was associated with faster responses under temporally uncertain threat, consistent with increased vigilance, while no association was found with physiological arousal. At the neural level, three connectivity patterns emerged and remained significant after sequential family-wise error correction. Behavioural responses modulated by subclinical anxiety were linked to stronger connectivity between the anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) and insula. Physiological modulation was associated with connectivity between the ACC and orbitofrontal cortex (OFC). Subjective anxiety was associated with increased connectivity between the hippocampus and insula. Additional connections were observed but did not survive stricter correction. Overall, the findings indicate that behavioural, physiological, and subjective aspects of subclinical anxiety map onto partially dissociable but overlapping intrinsic brain networks, extending prior task-based results to resting-state connectivity and informing future work on early neural markers of anxiety.
papers.title_zh: 亚临床焦虑的体验和表达背后的内在大脑网络
papers.abstract_zh: 焦虑包括并不总是一致的行为、生理和主观成分，目前尚不清楚这些维度是否由不同的内在大脑网络支持。在双系统框架的指导下，我们测试了静息态功能连接（rsFC）是否能够区分亚临床焦虑中的这些组成部分。 47 名具有不同亚临床焦虑水平的年轻人完成了威胁预期任务，测量行为反应（反应时间）和生理唤醒（皮肤电导），以及 NIH 恐惧影响自我报告的焦虑严重程度。这些措施与使用感兴趣区域分析的 rsFC 相关。较高的亚临床焦虑与在暂时不确定的威胁下更快的反应有关，与警惕性的提高一致，但与生理唤醒没有关联。在神经水平上，出现了三种连接模式，并且在顺序家族错误纠正后仍然很重要。由亚临床焦虑调节的行为反应与前扣带皮层（ACC）和岛叶之间更强的连接有关。生理调节与 ACC 和眶额皮质 (OFC) 之间的连接有关。主观焦虑与海马体和岛叶之间的连通性增加有关。观察到额外的连接，但未经过更严格的校正。总体而言，研究结果表明，亚临床焦虑的行为、生理和主观方面映射到部分分离但重叠的内在大脑网络，将先前基于任务的结果扩展到静息状态连接，并为未来关于焦虑早期神经标记的研究提供信息。

papers.title: Marshall meets Bartik: Revisiting the mysteries of the trade
papers.abstract: We identify a causal effect of top inventor inflows on the patent productivity of local inventors by combining the idea-generating process described by Marshall (1890) with the Bartik (1991) instruments involving the state taxes and commuting zone characteristics of the United States. We find that local productivity gains go beyond organizational boundaries and co-inventor relationships, which implies the partially nonexcludable good nature of knowledge in a spatial economy and pertains to the mysteries of the trade in the air. Our counterfactual experiment suggests that the spatial distribution of inventive activity is substantially distorted by the presence of state tax differences.
papers.title_zh: 马歇尔会见巴蒂克：重温贸易之谜
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过将 Marshall (1890) 描述的创意生成过程与涉及美国州税和通勤区特征的 Bartik (1991) 工具相结合，确定了顶级发明人的流入对当地发明人的专利生产力的因果影响。我们发现，当地生产力的提高超越了组织边界和共同发明者关系，这意味着空间经济中知识的部分非排他性良好本质，并且与空中贸易的奥秘有关。我们的反事实实验表明，发明活动的空间分布因州税收差异的存在而受到严重扭曲。

papers.title: An Adaptive Variable Neighborhood Search for a Family of Set Covering Routing Problems with an Application in Disaster Relief Operations
papers.abstract: This paper studies a variant of the Set Covering Routing Problem (SCRP) motivated by post-disaster humanitarian logistics. We consider a hybrid distribution concept in which the majority of transportation is performed by helicopters, while ground transport is limited to the last mile, addressing severe accessibility constraints in disaster-affected regions. The resulting problem integrates landing site location, routing, and covering decisions, incorporating features of the Multi-Vehicle Covering Tour Problem (m-CTP) and the Vehicle Routing with Demand Allocation Problem (VRDAP) in a facility-capacitated, multi-depot setting. Due to the computational complexity of the problem, we develop an Adaptive Variable Neighborhood Search (AVNS) that combines established routing operators with novel mechanisms for covering decisions. The performance of the proposed approach is evaluated on benchmark instances for the related m-CTP and VRDAP problems, demonstrating competitive solution quality compared to problem-specific state-of-the-art approaches. Furthermore, we apply our AVNS to a real-world case study based on the 2024 flash floods in Afghanistan. The results highlight the practical relevance of the proposed framework and provide managerial insights into effective distribution strategies for disaster response operations.
papers.title_zh: 自适应变量邻域搜索集覆盖路由问题及其在救灾行动中的应用
papers.abstract_zh: 本文研究了受灾后人道主义物流推动的集合覆盖路由问题 (SRP) 的变体。我们考虑采用混合配送概念，其中大部分运输由直升机执行，而地面运输仅限于最后一英里，以解决受灾地区严重的可达性限制。由此产生的问题集成了着陆点位置、路线和覆盖决策，将多车辆覆盖巡视问题 (m-CTP) 和车辆路线与需求分配问题 (VRDAP) 的特征结合在设施容量、多仓库设置中。由于问题的计算复杂性，我们开发了一种自适应变量邻域搜索（AVNS），它将已建立的路由算子与覆盖决策的新颖机制结合起来。所提出方法的性能在相关 m-CTP 和 VRDAP 问题的基准实例上进行了评估，证明了与特定问题的最先进方法相比具有竞争力的解决方案质量。此外，我们将 AVNS 应用于基于 2024 年阿富汗山洪爆发的现实案例研究。结果强调了所提出框架的实际相关性，并为灾害应对行动的有效分配策略提供了管理见解。

papers.title: One-shot emergency psychiatric triage across 15 frontier AI chatbots
papers.abstract: AI chatbots are increasingly used for health advice, but their performance in psychiatric triage remains undercharacterized. Psychiatric triage is particularly challenging because urgency must often be inferred from thoughts, behavior, and context rather than from objective findings.   We evaluated the performance of 15 frontier AI chatbots on psychiatric triage from realistic single-message disclosures using 112 clinical vignettes, each paired with 1 of 4 original benchmark triage labels: A, routine; B, assessment within 1 week; C, assessment within 24 to 48 hours; and D, emergency care now. Vignettes covered 9 psychiatric presentation clusters and 9 focal risk dimensions, organized into 28 presentation-by-risk groups. Each group contributed 4 distinct vignettes, with 1 vignette at each triage level. Each vignette was rendered as a realistic human-authored conversational query, and the AI chatbots were tasked with assigning a triage label from that disclosure.   Emergency under-triage occurred in 23 of 410 level D trials (5.6%), and all under-triaged emergencies were reassigned to level C urgency. Across target models, average accuracy ranged from 42.0% to 71.8%. Accuracy was highest for level D vignettes (94.3%) and lowest for level B vignettes (19.7%). Mean signed ordinal error was positive (+0.47 triage levels), indicating net over-triage. Dispersion was highest around the middle triage levels. All results were confirmed relative to clinician consensus labels from 50 medical doctors.   When presented with user messages containing sufficient clinical information, frontier AI chatbots thus recognized psychiatric emergencies as requiring urgent medical assessment with near-zero error rates, yet showed marked over-triage for low and intermediate risk presentations.
papers.title_zh: 跨 15 个前沿人工智能聊天机器人进行一次性紧急精神科分类
papers.abstract_zh: 人工智能聊天机器人越来越多地用于健康建议，但它们在精神科分诊方面的表现仍然不够充分。精神病学分类尤其具有挑战性，因为紧迫性通常必须根据想法、行为和背景而不是客观发现来推断。   我们使用 112 个临床小插图，根据现实的单消息披露，评估了 15 个前沿人工智能聊天机器人在精神科分诊方面的表现，每个小插图都与 4 个原始基准分诊标签中的 1 个配对：A，常规； B、1周内评估； C、24至48小时内评估； D，现在紧急护理。插图涵盖 9 个精神病学表现集群和 9 个焦点风险维度，分为 28 个按风险表现的组。每个小组贡献 4 个不同的小插图，每个分类级别有 1 个小插图。每个小插图都被渲染为真实的人类创作的对话查询，人工智能聊天机器人的任务是根据该披露分配一个分类标签。   410 项 D 级试验中有 23 项（5.6%）发生了紧急分类不足，所有未分类的紧急情况均被重新分配为 C 级紧急情况。在目标模型中，平均准确度范围为 42.0% 到 71.8%。 D 级晕影的准确度最高 (94.3%)，B 级晕影的准确度最低 (19.7%)。平均符号序数误差为正（+0.47 分类水平），表明净过度分类。中间分类级别附近的分散度最高。所有结果均根据 50 名医生的临床医生共识标签得到证实。   当收到包含足够临床信息的用户消息时，前沿人工智能聊天机器人会以接近零的错误率识别出精神科紧急情况，需要紧急医疗评估，但对低风险和中风险的情况表现出明显的过度分类。

papers.title: What Drives Contagion? Identifying and Attributing Cross-Border Transmission Mechanisms
papers.abstract: We address the joint detection-and-attribution problem in cross-border financial contagion through a two-stage framework. The first stage applies wavelet-quantile transfer entropy across time-scales and lower, median, and upper-tail quantiles. The second stage attributes each significant link to one of five channels comprising of i) Trade, ii) Financial, iii) Geopolitical, iv) Behavioural, and v) Monetary Policy, via instrumental-variables two-stage least squares with channel-specific external instruments, LASSO-based instrument selection (Belloni, Chernozhukov and Hansen, 2014), local projections at one-, five-, and twenty-two-day horizons (Jorda, 2005), heteroskedasticity-based identification (Rigobon, 2003) for episodes in which over-identification is rejected, and Cinelli-Hazlett (2020) sensitivity bounds. The framework is applied to 18 G20 equity markets across eight crisis sub-periods spanning January 2006 to March 2026. Network density varies meaningfully across sub-periods (range 14% to 32%). Dominant-channel identification is robust across methods in the Pre-Crisis baseline and the European Sovereign Debt Crisis, both dominated by financial frictions; for the remaining six episodes identification is method-sensitive, and we report the share posterior alongside an explicit identification-status classification. Trade is empirically prominent across all post-2007 episodes, ranging from 9% during Pre-Crisis to 28% during the Global Financial Crisis. The behavioural channel is bounded above by 22% across all eight episodes under the de-confounded composite. The framework provides a methodologically disciplined account of cross-border contagion mechanisms and offers identification-status disclosure not systematically present in the existing literature.
papers.title_zh: 是什么推动了传染？识别和归因跨境传播机制
papers.abstract_zh: 我们通过两阶段框架解决跨境金融传染中的联合检测和归因问题。第一阶段在时间尺度和下分位数、中分位数和上尾分位数上应用小波分位数传递熵。第二阶段将每个重要联系归因于五个渠道之一，包括i）贸易，ii）金融，iii）地缘政治，iv）行为和v）货币政策，通过工具变量两阶段最小二乘法与特定渠道的外部工具，基于LASSO的工具选择（Belloni，Chernozhukov和Hansen，2014），一天，五天和二十二天的本地预测（Jorda，2005）、基于异方差性的识别（Rigobon，2003）拒绝过度识别的事件，以及 Cinelli-Hazlett（2020）敏感性界限。该框架适用于 2006 年 1 月至 2026 年 3 月八个危机子时期的 18 个 G20 股票市场。不同子时期的网络密度存在显着差异（范围为 14% 至 32%）。在危机前基线和欧洲主权债务危机中，主导渠道识别在各种方法中都是稳健的，这两种危机都以金融摩擦为主导；对于其余六集，识别是方法敏感的，我们报告共享后验以及明确的识别状态分类。从经验来看，贸易在 2007 年之后的所有时期中都很突出，从危机前的 9% 到全球金融危机期间的 28%。在去混杂的组合下，所有八个情节中的行为通道的界限都在 22% 以上。该框架提供了对跨境传染机制的方法论上严格的说明，并提供了现有文献中未系统地提供的身份识别状态披露。

papers.title: The Signal Credibility Index for Prediction Markets: A Microstructure-Grounded Diagnostic with Weighted and Time-Varying Extensions
papers.abstract: Prediction-market price moves are widely treated as informationally equivalent: a price jump is read the same way regardless of whether it reflects durable Bayesian updating, transient liquidity pressure, strategic position adjustment, or genuine disagreement. This paper formalizes the Signal Credibility Index (SCI) introduced in Nechepurenko (2026) as a stand-alone diagnostic. We make four contributions: (i) a revised persistence component using the persistence ratio PR(t,w) on logit prices, well-defined on short rolling windows; (ii) a weighted Cobb-Douglas form SCI(ααα) with flow-based concentration HHI_flow; (iii) a time-varying specification SCI(t; w) for real-time monitoring; and (iv) Monte Carlo validation including an out-of-distribution stress test, coordinated multi-wallet manipulation, and a logistic-regression benchmark. The validation establishes discrimination among designed microstructure regimes, not external evidence of downstream coordination effects. We document two failure modes consistent with the index targeting coordination credibility rather than pure information content: a Type II error on informed-but-concentrated whale repricing, and a Type I error on coordinated multi-wallet manipulation.
papers.title_zh: 预测市场的信号可信度指数：具有加权和时变扩展的基于微观结构的诊断
papers.abstract_zh: 预测市场价格变动被广泛视为信息等价：无论价格上涨是否反映持久的贝叶斯更新、短暂的流动性压力、战略头寸调整或真正的分歧，它都以相同的方式解读。本文将 Nechepurenko (2026) 中引入的信号可信度指数 (SCI) 正式化为独立诊断。我们做出了四个贡献：（i）使用 logit 价格上的持久性比率 PR(t,w) 修改持久性组件，在短滚动窗口上明确定义； (ii) 具有基于流量的浓度 HHI_flow 的加权柯布-道格拉斯形式 SCI(ααα)； (iii) 用于实时监控的时变规范 SCI(t; w)； (iv) 蒙特卡罗验证，包括分布外压力测试、协调的多钱包操作和逻辑回归基准。该验证建立了设计的微观结构体系之间的区别，而不是下游协调效应的外部证据。我们记录了两种与针对协调可信度而非纯粹信息内容的指数一致的故障模式：关于知情但集中的鲸鱼重新定价的 II 型错误，以及协调多钱包操纵的 I 型错误。

papers.title: When Agents Shop for You: Role Coherence in AI-Mediated Markets
papers.abstract: Consumers are increasingly delegating purchase decisions to AI agents, providing natural-language descriptions of their preferences and identity. We argue that these representations constitute an information channel, role coherence, through which sellers can infer willingness to pay without explicit disclosure by the buyer agent, leading to preference leakage. In an experiment where a language-model buyer agent shops on behalf of a verbal consumer profile, we show that seller-side inference from dialogue alone recovers willingness to pay nearly one-for-one. Comparing this setting to a numeric-budget condition with confidentiality instructions cleanly isolates role coherence as distinct from instruction-following failure. Because this leakage arises from delegation itself, it cannot be mitigated at the prompt level. Instead, we propose architectural interventions that trade off personalization against preference privacy.
papers.title_zh: 当代理商为您购物时：人工智能介导的市场中的角色一致性
papers.abstract_zh: 消费者越来越多地将购买决策委托给人工智能代理，以自然语言描述他们的偏好和身份。我们认为，这些表示构成了一种信息渠道，即角色一致性，通过该渠道，卖方可以在买方代理人不明确披露的情况下推断出支付意愿，从而导致偏好泄漏。在一项实验中，语言模型买家代理代表口头消费者资料进行购物，我们表明，仅通过对话进行的卖方推断就恢复了几乎一对一支付的意愿。将此设置与具有机密性指令的数字预算条件进行比较，可以清楚地将角色一致性与指令遵循失败区分开来。由于这种泄漏是由授权本身引起的，因此无法立即缓解。相反，我们提出了一种架构干预措施，可以在个性化和偏好隐私之间进行权衡。
